data.one_liner: Shows a customizable animated alert banner at the top or bottom of the screen.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a function to display an alert banner with any widget as its content. It supports positioning, tap callbacks, and simple animation out of the box.
use_when: you need a quick, lightweight way to show temporary messages
you want a banner that can contain custom widgets
you prefer a single function call over building a custom overlay
avoid_when: you require complex interaction patterns or multi‑step flows
you need built‑in theming or extensive style customization beyond the provided options
weaknesses: no built‑in theming or dark‑mode handling
